title.zh: 飞书只读调研与知识库本地增量同步

pain.zh: 团队文档、Wiki 和多维表格全沉淀在飞书里，想盘点目录层级、迁移到本地 Obsidian / Git，或者排查应用权限缺哪一条，手动点开几十个页面抄到手软，又怕 AI 一上来用个人权限乱翻或误改远端文档。
pain.en: When team knowledge lives in Feishu Wiki and Drive, auditing folder structures, diagnosing minimal app scopes, or backing up pages to local Markdown/Git by hand is slow—and running scripts with broad user OAuth or write access feels risky.

solution.zh: 以飞书官方 `lark-cli` 为唯一通道，默认用受限应用身份 `bot`（`tenant_access_token`）只读运行：严格分离 Wiki 与 Drive 接口，先盘点可见范围与权限缺口；同步知识库时先跑 `--dry-run` 再小点试跑、全量增量镜像并校验完整性，绝不猜测个人资源或修改远端文档。
solution.en: Drive official `lark-cli` read-only using least-privilege `bot` (`tenant_access_token`) by default: separate Wiki vs. Drive APIs, audit scope gaps safely, and mirror authorized spaces to local Markdown/Git via `--dry-run`, pilot sync, incremental update, and `--validate-only` checks.

steps.title: 身份分流与凭证诊断
steps.desc: 默认 `bot` 只读（仅显式请求个人云盘才用用户 OAuth）；遇错先排查 `errors.yml` 再开最小权限。

steps.title: Wiki/Drive 独立盘点
steps.desc: 分别枚举知识空间、节点树与文档类型，明示哪些目录因未对应用开放而不可见。

steps.title: 先 dry-run 再试点增量同步
steps.desc: `sync_feishu_wiki.py` 先 `--dry-run`，再 `--pilot-node-token` 小范围验证，最后全量增量同步。

steps.title: 校验收口绝不顺手推送
steps.desc: 跑 `--validate-only` 与失败重跑；默认停在本地 Markdown，不自动 Git commit/push。

guardrails: 绝不在命令行裸传密钥（stdin 注入凭证），绝不把 Secret/Token 写进日志或仓库
绝不因 bot 搜不到就静默切换个人 user OAuth
远端写操作或导出需单独展示命令与影响并获当次确认

steps.title: Least-privilege auth check
steps.desc: Default to `bot` (`tenant_access_token`); diagnose credentials cleanly via `errors.yml`.

steps.title: Separate Wiki & Drive inventory
steps.desc: List spaces, node trees, and doc types while flagging bot-invisible permissions explicitly.

steps.title: Dry-run, pilot, incremental sync
steps.desc: Run `sync_feishu_wiki.py --dry-run`, pilot one node, then sync incrementally.

steps.title: Validate without auto-pushing
steps.desc: Verify sync integrity with `--validate-only`; never auto-commit or push to Git.

guardrails: Credentials passed via stdin only; never leaked to logs, vault, or repo
Never silently escalate from bot to personal user OAuth
Any remote write or export requires explicit per-command confirmation

title.zh: ProcessOn 图表安全盘点、受控导出与本地解析

pain.zh: 团队在 ProcessOn 里攒了几百张架构图和脑图，想全量盘点或归档成 VSDX / XMind / POS 备份到本地：手动逐张点下载会漏掉深层子目录、碰到同名覆盖，还怕自动化脚本去附着你正在用的日常 Chrome，搞乱登录态或误删远端文件。
pain.en: Backing up hundreds of ProcessOn diagrams into local VSDX/XMind/POS archives by hand misses nested folders and causes filename collisions—while naive browser automation risks hijacking your daily Chrome profile.

solution.zh: 坚持三阶段严格隔离与「永不碰主浏览器」：在技能专属独立浏览器 profile 内只读递归盘点、生成可断点审计的快照（支持两份快照离线做增量对比）；第二阶段先建受控导出计划，经同盘 staging 校验格式与 SHA-256 后无复制归档；第三阶段按需离线解析 POS/XMind/SVG/PDF 内容。
solution.en: Three isolated stages using a dedicated skill-only browser profile (never touching your daily Chrome): read-only recursive inventory with checkpoint audit & snapshot diffing; staged downloads verified by SHA-256 before atomic move; and optional offline parsing of POS/XMind/SVG/PDF exports.

steps.title: Stage 1 · 只读递归盘点
steps.desc: 专用 profile 分批审计至叶子目录（discovered - visited - blocked = 0 方算全量），支持增量对比。

steps.title: Stage 2 · staging 校验与归档
steps.desc: 先出下载计划，单写者串行下载至同盘 staging，核完大小与 SHA-256 再原子 move。

steps.title: 碰撞与未知类型隔离
steps.desc: 重名冲突与无法判别类型进人工确认清单，绝不静默覆盖或猜格式。

steps.title: Stage 3 · 本地离线解析
steps.desc: 按需用 `inspect_processon_export.py` 解析 POS/XMind/SVG/PDF 标题与节点。

guardrails: 严禁附着客户日常默认 Chrome profile
全程只读远端：绝不修改、分享、移动或删除线上图表
正常或异常退出浏览器都必须关闭页面并交关闭回执

steps.title: Stage 1 · Read-only inventory
steps.desc: Audit nested folders in an isolated profile with checkpoints and snapshot diffing.

steps.title: Stage 2 · Staged download & move
steps.desc: Build plan, download to same-filesystem staging, verify SHA-256, and move atomically.

steps.title: Isolate collisions & unknowns
steps.desc: Queue ambiguous types and name collisions for explicit confirmation—never overwrite.

steps.title: Stage 3 · Offline export inspection
steps.desc: Parse local POS/XMind/SVG/PDF structures on demand without touching the cloud.

guardrails: Never attach to your default daily Chrome profile
Strictly read-only remotely: zero edits, shares, moves, or deletes
Guaranteed browser page cleanup receipt even on error exit

title.zh: 以真实观点为骨、Vault 摘抄为料的成文工坊
title.en: Draft Composition from Your Views & Vault

pain.zh: 让普通 AI 直接帮你写文章，写出来往往一股浓浓的「套路开场 + 假金句 + 空洞排比」AI 味，还经常替你编造观点；另外公众号要求的单篇 `digest` 摘要、合集引语和正文首段也常常混在一起。
pain.en: Asking a generic AI to write an article yields templated clichés, fake quotes, and invented opinions—while mixing up collection intros, prefaces, and per-article digests.

solution.zh: 守住「以你的真实观点为骨、你的 vault 摘抄为料」：把合集引语、长序与单篇 `digest` 严格拆进 frontmatter 而不污染正文首段；按体裁锁定「流量钩子体」与「极简意象体」不混用；发表前还支持只检不擅改的勘误对照、去 AI 味和 `6-gram/8-gram` 原创防撞库打散重写。
solution.en: Anchor every draft in your real views and vault clips without fabricating opinions: isolate `series_intro`, `preface`, and `digest` in frontmatter, keep hook vs. essay styles separate, run pre-publish typo/AI-tone audits, and support structural rewrites checked against `6-gram`/`8-gram` overlap.

steps.title: 收料定调绝不编造
steps.desc: 收集指定笔记的「我的看法」与 `[[双链]]` 摘抄，缺料直接问你，绝不脑补立场。

steps.title: 正文与元数据分离
steps.desc: 写规范 frontmatter，把合集总推/序言与 20–40 字单篇 `digest` 分离，正文干净起笔。

steps.title: 体裁锁定不串味
steps.desc: 知乎/科普「流量钩子体」与自省随笔「极简意象体」严格分界。

steps.title: 勘误、去 AI 味与防撞
steps.desc: 先列勘误对照确认再改，清套路空话，重创作自检 `6-gram/8-gram` 重叠趋近 0%。

guardrails: 绝不替用户编造未表达过的观点或案例
原稿勘误先出「位置/原文/建议/原因」对照表，确认后再改
只写草稿目录，不改摘抄原文，不越界触发排版或发布

steps.title: Gather real views & sources
steps.desc: Read your `## 我的看法` and vault clips; ask if material is missing—never invent stance.

steps.title: Separate prose & metadata
steps.desc: Place `series_intro`, `preface`, and 20–40 char `digest` cleanly into frontmatter.

steps.title: Enforce genre discipline
steps.desc: Keep hook-driven explainers separate from minimal literary essays.

steps.title: Audit, de-AI & anti-overlap
steps.desc: Produce typo diff tables first, strip AI clichés, and check 6/8-gram originality.

guardrails: Never fabricate user opinions or fake examples
Present typo/errata diff table before editing existing drafts
Writes only to draft directory; never modifies source clips or publishes

title.zh: 基于组合轴与中华传统色的配图与 SVG 工坊
title.en: Axis-Driven Editorial Artwork & Vector SVG Studio

pain.zh: 用生图模型配文章封面或信息图，十有八九长这样：文字写错乱码、公众号 `2.35:1` 首图转发到朋友圈被 `1:1` 裁掉半个标题、45 秒手机海报字密到看不清，或者随便塞一张和文章内容毫不相干的赛博朋克图。
pain.en: Generic AI images for articles often break on real publishing requirements: garbled Chinese text, titles cropped off in WeChat's `1:1` share preview from a `2.35:1` banner, unreadable walls of text, or mismatched stock sci-fi art.

solution.zh: 把配图工程化成「渐进路由 + 七块规范 Prompt + 实图验收」：支持公众号 `2.35:1`（必检中央 `1:1` 安全区）+ 正文配图、30–45 秒手机信息海报（严控 ≤220 字）、中国传统构图 20 式与 742 种中华传统色（绝不把 HEX 印进画面）、1–6 页自适应康奈尔笔记图，以及社交卡与确定性矢量 SVG Logo。
solution.en: Turn illustration into an auditable pipeline: route cleanly across WeChat `2.35:1` banners (with `1:1` center-crop checks), mobile posters (`<=220` chars), 20 traditional Chinese compositions & 742 colors, adaptive 1–6 page Cornell visual notes, social cards, and deterministic vector SVGs—always verified visually.

steps.title: L0 需求确认不盲猜
steps.desc: 用途模糊时先给支持目录反问确认，清晰时直接按家族与组合轴编译。

steps.title: 七块规范 Prompt 落盘
steps.desc: 从文章提取真实事实，先落盘含七个标准块与严格文字清单的 `prompts/NN.md`。

steps.title: 按通道选渲染引擎
steps.desc: 位图走 `imagegen`、高字密/排版走无头浏览器 `html_render`、图标/Logo 走确定性 SVG。

steps.title: 实测看图不过再重绘
steps.desc: 必用 `view_image` 检查文字、比例与 `1:1` 安全区；有错改单一主因用新文件名重生。

guardrails: 绝不用 Pillow/Canvas 在出错位图上强行贴字遮丑
绝不把色彩 HEX 代码或内部布局术语印到图片里
绝不伪造二维码、虚假评分或不存在的 URL

steps.title: Clarify or route cleanly
steps.desc: Ask via L0 catalog if ambiguous; otherwise resolve composition axes immediately.

steps.title: Compile 7-block prompt
steps.desc: Ground facts from source material and write `prompts/NN.md` before rendering.

steps.title: Match engine to deliverable
steps.desc: Use `imagegen` for art, `html_render` for dense text, and `svg_deterministic` for logos.

steps.title: Visual QA with `view_image`
steps.desc: Inspect actual pixels for text accuracy, aspect ratio, and `1:1` safe-zone framing.

guardrails: Never patch garbled AI text with Pillow/Canvas overlays
Never leak raw HEX codes or prompt metadata onto rendered images
Never fabricate QR codes, ratings, or fake URLs

title.zh: 小红书笔记改写与当次授权网页代传草稿
title.en: Rednote Adaptation & Authorized Web Draft Flow

pain.zh: 把公众号长文改发小红书，最容易踩三个坑：直接照搬长段没人看；超过 1000 字不知道走「写长文」还是拆文字卡；或者用了第三方逆向发帖脚本结果泄露 Cookie 甚至触发风控封号。
pain.en: Adapting long articles for Rednote often fails when copying dense paragraphs verbatim, mis-handling `>1000` char long-form layouts, or risking account bans by using unofficial reverse-engineered posting APIs.

solution.zh: 默认只交付干净可直接复制的 Rednote Markdown 文案（单一角度 + 承诺明确标题 + 3–5 段短文 + 5–10 个精准标签 + 配图建议），超过 1000 字优先适配官方「写长文」路线；仅当你明确授权时，才在你自己已登录的官方网页端代为传图、填文、点选蓝色标签，并在点发布前截图停下等你确认。
solution.en: Outputs copy-ready Rednote Markdown by default (single angle, grounded title, 3–5 punchy paragraphs, 5–10 narrow tags, and visual briefs—routing `>1000` char posts to official long-form formatting). Only with your per-run approval does it fill your already logged-in web composer, stopping with a screenshot before clicking Publish.

steps.desc: 短笔记精炼为 3–5 段；超 1000 字优先适配官方「写长文」或拆 4–8 张自产卡。

steps.title: 当次授权才进网页填稿
steps.desc: 在你已登录的创作服务平台传图、填文、逐个下拉点选蓝色标签、按需挂 Red Skill。

guardrails: 严禁使用任何第三方逆向签名包或私有接口，防泄露 Cookie 与封号

绝不把「已生成文案」或草稿态冒充成「线上已发布」

title.zh: 公众号内联 HTML 排版、机械校验与只推草稿箱
title.en: WeChat Inline HTML Validation & Draft-Only Push

pain.zh: 写完公众号 Markdown 往后台粘贴总是灾难：外链 CSS 全被剥离、样式乱掉、代码块崩坏、图片还要一张张手动上传；更麻烦的是改两个错字重新推送，结果草稿箱里又多出一条重复草稿。
pain.en: Pasting Markdown into WeChat MP strips external CSS, breaks code blocks, forces manual image uploads—and re-pushing after a small typo fix creates duplicate drafts.

solution.zh: 绝不擅改你的正文与标题，专注把排版和投递做成零失误流水线：先渲染严格内联样式 HTML 与带 390px 手机预览的 `.copy.html` 一键复制工作台；过机械红线校验后按需走三级通道（零配置 `.copy.html` 复制 / 浏览器存草稿 / 官方 API 多账号推草稿或原地 `draft/update`）；发表后还能把正文连同 `assets/` 一键归档。
solution.en: Preserves your prose and title untouched while automating inline-style HTML rendering, mechanical rule linting (`validate_wechat_html.py`), 390px mobile preview `.copy.html`, and 3 delivery tiers—including in-place `draft/update` by `media_id` and post-publish archiving. Never auto-broadcasts.

AppSecret 与 access_token 绝不落入仓库、vault 或终端回执

title.zh: X 推文串拆条与 X Articles 长文草稿箱投递
title.en: X Thread Splitter & X Articles Draft Uploader

pain.zh: 把中文长文拆成 X Thread 发出去，经常每条超了 280 字符、代码块和链接被拆断；而想发 X Articles 长文时，在网页编辑器里手动重新排版、逐张补插图又慢又容易丢样式，还担心自动化脚本错点 Publish。
pain.en: Turning long posts into X threads often breaks code snippets or exceeds the 280-char limit—while pasting Markdown + inline images into X Articles manually is tedious, and nobody wants a script accidentally clicking Publish.

solution.zh: 把 X 的两个出口做成明确分级授权：做 Thread 默认只交付每条严格 ≤280 字符（代码与链接保持原样）的 Markdown 文本，获授权才经 `x_post.py` 填入草稿；做 X Articles 先用无浏览器预检解析标题/封面/插图位置，再在可见浏览器中富文本粘贴、按原位插图并机械校验，源码里根本没有点击 Publish 的代码路径。
solution.en: Cleanly split X workflows by authorization tier: Threads default to copy-ready `<=280`-char Markdown blocks keeping code and links intact (browser fill/send only when explicitly approved); X Articles dry-run parse first, then paste rich text + inline images in a visible browser and save to drafts only—with no Publish code path at all.
